property_summary: For any queried bytes4 interface selector, c.supportsInterface returns true exactly when the selector is the ERC165 id (0x01ffc9a7) or the AccessControl id (computed at runtime as the XOR of hasRole/getRoleAdmin/grantRole/revokeRole/renounceRole selectors); the mutant drops the AccessControl check so it returns false for the AccessControl id.

For any interfaceId, C.supportsInterface returns true only for the IERC165 and IAccessControl interface IDs and false for every other id; the mutant returns true unconditionally, violating this for any unrelated interfaceId.

For any interfaceId other than the IERC165 (0x01ffc9a7) and IAccessControl (0x7965db0b) interface ids, C.supportsInterface returns false, whereas the mutant returns true unconditionally, so any unrelated id breaks the bug.
